caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden highboy chest with a reddish-brown hue. It features a total of eight visible drawers arranged in two sections: the upper section has five drawers, including two smaller ones at the top, with a fan-shaped carved detail on the central uppermost drawer. The lower section contains three drawers, with one larger central drawer flanked by two smaller ones. The chest stands on four cabriole legs with pad feet. The top of the highboy has a broken arch pediment with three finials: one in the center and one at each end, all with spiral detailing. Ornate metal handles adorn each drawer. The highboy is illustrated on a plain, off-white background, with the artist's signature "H.F. MILLER" at the bottom right.
title: High-boy
